text: Lost Vertex Retail after competitor came in 14 percent below our list price on the SMB bundle. Buyer said pricing was the only reason.
Prospect asked for a match against a competitor quote. Discount request beyond my approval band so the deal slipped to next quarter.
Three SMB deals above 5K ACV stalled this week. Common theme in every call is competitor pricing pressure on the entry bundle.
Customer disputes invoice date. Invoice was issued nine days after order confirmation following the billing platform cutover.
Billing migration batch failed overnight. Invoice generation queued and released with a delay of about nine days.
Second batch of delayed invoices released. Revenue recognition for these orders moves into the following period.
Renewal at risk. Customer benchmarking us against the competitor entry tier and asking for a 12 percent reduction.
Enterprise pipeline is healthy. No pricing pressure reported in North this month.
Shipment damage on two pallets. Returns raised under the standard damage clause.
Win rate in South SMB is materially below plan. Deals under 5K ACV still closing, larger SMB deals are not.
Customer returned four units citing a change in the returns window communicated by the reseller, not by us.
Return volume up slightly. Product inspection found no defect trend, units resold as new.
Competitor is bundling implementation for free. We are still charging for it in the SMB tier.
Backlog of delayed invoices cleared for MID segment. SMB batch still pending validation.
Seasonal slowdown as expected for late August. Pipeline coverage unchanged versus last year.
Reseller confirmed they extended their own returns window to 45 days without notifying us. This may be inflating our return rate.
Requesting approval for a temporary competitive discount band for SMB deals in South.
Satisfaction survey responses trending up. Customers cite faster onboarding since the July release.
